acceptanceCriteria: Rerunning dogfood-change over an uncommitted bound map yields the same citation set as one run, or refuses before any write with a typed code
A test covers the second-pass case
body: Lane dogfood-1021g (#1443, base ae3b418152fe4c42f52ac7cfdc16ecc12159607e, 2026-10-21) observed that rerunning dogfood-change while the bound map is still uncommitted appends the new citation rows to the existing ones instead of replacing them, so the map carries duplicate or stale citations. The refusal's fix line explains the recovery, but the trap stays. Expected: a rerun over an uncommitted map either replaces its citations idempotently or refuses up front with a typed code before writing.

title: A second dogfood-change pass appends citations to an uncommitted map instead of replacing them
